free_tier.stated: free personal mail at a Yandex address only; the free version of Yandex 360 for Business, which carried mail on a custom domain, is no longer available as of December 8, 2025, except for non-profit organizations and charities

tooling: web mail and the official mobile app; an organization admin can enable IMAP for email clients under Mail settings
chaining: a mailbox rather than a sender, and the custom-domain feature that would make it useful moved behind the paid tier.

limits.value: a custom domain requires a Yandex 360 for Business plan, from USD 3.99 per employee per month on Basic as 360.yandex.com lists it

identity_cost.detail: a Yandex ID: name and surname, a username, a password, and a mobile phone number confirmed by an SMS code; the registration help names no country

interface_detail: webmail and the mobile apps, and IMAP at imap.yandex.com (port 993, SSL) and SMTP at smtp.yandex.com (port 465, SSL; port 587 for a connection opened without encryption) with an app password, for personal mailboxes and for organization mailboxes where an administrator enables the protocols; the custom-domain feature is a business-plan SKU
limits_note: reported by third-party posts that quote a notice sent to organizations without a plan, and stated on no first-party page read: IMAP, SMTP and POP3 become unavailable without a Yandex 360 plan from the date in the notice, June 29 in the first notice quoted and later dates in later notices, leaving webmail and the mobile app; the same posts report that personal mailboxes are not affected, and whether non-profit organizations that keep the services free are affected is unverified
